Quick Answer

A private transfer from Riyadh to Al Qassim Airport — officially Prince Naif bin Abdulaziz International Airport, code ELQ — is roughly 375 km by road, about 3.5 hours depending on your pickup point and traffic. The vehicle is arranged for your own party, not shared, and the fare is confirmed on WhatsApp before you book.

Frequently Asked Questions

Can I book a private taxi from Riyadh to Al Qassim Airport?

Yes. Send your Riyadh pickup address, date, passengers and luggage on WhatsApp. We check partner availability and confirm one fare for the whole vehicle before you book.

What is the airport code for Al Qassim Airport?

The IATA code is ELQ and the ICAO code is OEGS. Some booking sites list it as Gassim, Qassim or Buraidah airport.

What is the official name of Al Qassim Airport?

Prince Naif bin Abdulaziz International Airport. It serves Buraydah and the wider Al Qassim Province.

How long does it take to travel from Riyadh to ELQ Airport?

Roughly 3.5 hours over about 375 km from central Riyadh. The exact time depends on your pickup district, traffic and road conditions, so allow a margin before a flight.

How much does a private transfer from Riyadh to Al Qassim Airport cost?

The fare depends on the vehicle category, date and availability. We confirm one fare on WhatsApp before you book, with no meter and no surge.

Can I book a GMC or SUV?

Yes, subject to availability. A full-size SUV such as a GMC suits families and extra luggage; tell us the party size and we confirm the right vehicle.

Can I book a sedan for one or two passengers?

Yes. A sedan suits one or two travellers with moderate luggage. Add your luggage count so we confirm the vehicle fits.

Can I travel with family and luggage?

Yes. Give us the number of passengers and large cases and we recommend an SUV or larger vehicle so everyone and all bags travel together.

Can I arrange an airport drop-off?

Yes. Tell us your flight time and Riyadh pickup address and we work the pickup back from it, leaving a margin for the long road journey.

Can I book a return transfer from Al Qassim Airport to Riyadh?

Yes. Pickups at ELQ must be arranged in advance, not assumed. Share your flight number and destination and we confirm the pickup details before you travel.

Can I reserve a vehicle in advance?

Yes, and advance booking is recommended for a journey this long. Send your date and time and we check availability.

Are these private transfers rather than shared taxis?

Yes. The vehicle is arranged for your own party and is not shared with other passengers.

Can I request pickup from a hotel or home in Riyadh?

Yes. Send the hotel or address and we confirm coverage for that pickup point with our partner network.
